name: Box Breathing

frames.label: Settle
frames.cue: Sit comfortably and let your shoulders soften.

frames.label: Inhale Begin
frames.cue: Inhale gently through your nose for four counts.

frames.label: Inhale Full
frames.cue: Finish the inhale without lifting your shoulders.

frames.label: Hold Full
frames.cue: Hold softly for four counts; do not strain.

frames.label: Exhale
frames.cue: Exhale slowly and comfortably for four counts.

frames.label: Hold Empty Reset
frames.cue: Pause gently for four counts, then begin the next cycle.

safety: Keep every phase comfortable; shorten or remove holds if needed.
Never force the breath or continue through air hunger.
Return to normal breathing and stop for dizziness, chest pain, panic or shortness of breath.

aiCoachNote.prompt: How did Box Breathing feel? Note whether the four-count holds were comfortable and whether you felt calm, dizzy, anxious or short of breath.
